## Map of field site

```{r warning=FALSE}
library(leaflet)

leaflet() %>% 
  addTiles() %>%     
  addMarkers(lng = 47.028, lat = -119.965, popup = "The Feathers")
# 47°01'32.26"N 119°57'58.04"W
```
